en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, and Ibn Mahboub, from Muawiya Bin Wahab who said,
‘The pigeon is from the birds of the Prophets<sup>as</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from an ibn Mahbub from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahab who has said the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Pigeons are the birds of the Prophets, ‘Alayhim al- Salam.”’
